assumptions.gpu_node_cloud_price: 2 x the per-GPU price (cloud GPU prices include the host's vCPUs and RAM)
assumptions.cpu_cores: Clipper's Xeon Gold 6230R (2019, 2.1 GHz); cloud core prices are for newer cores, so the CPU side is probably 1.5-2x cheaper in the cloud than modelled here: see cpu_speed_sensitivity
assumptions.cpu_power: 650 W per dual EPYC 9654 server (192 cores) scaled per core; GPU node 1,400 W is an estimate (rates.json)
